purpose: Organization-level exposure assessment of supplied PingCAP incident archives; not proof of compromise of customer systems.
source_assurance: Hashes establish the identity of analyzed local files, not independent authenticity or completeness of the leaked material.

hk_connection_classes.legal_or_headquarters: Explicit Hong Kong legal entity or headquarters, corroborated where possible by official public sources.
hk_connection_classes.business_address: Hong Kong business or billing address in supplied records; may identify a branch, payer, reseller, or contact.
hk_connection_classes.profile_location: Hong Kong country or city in user/profile metadata; does not establish employer headquarters.
hk_connection_classes.domain_hint: A .hk business domain or name containing Hong Kong is a discovery signal; not independently sufficient.
hk_connection_classes.ip_geolocation: Offline approximate country classification of a logged client address; no inference of company nationality or physical user location.

exposure_classes.crm_or_commercial: Company/contact/business or billing record observed. Could concern a lead, partner, or payer.
exposure_classes.product_account: Evidence explicitly linking organization to a TiDB Cloud account or tenant.
exposure_classes.operational_or_support: Organization-attributed operational/support material, with exact evidence reference.
exposure_classes.gateway_activity: Rows linked through a supported cluster crosswalk, reported as log records, not distinct connections.
exposure_classes.credential_material: Only a masked category indicator if attributable material is observed; usability never tested or assumed.

confidence_rule: Report Hong Kong identity confidence and exposure attribution confidence separately. Public customer/partner pages corroborate a relationship, not breach impact. Do not merge organizations through reseller/payer links without direct evidence.
privacy: Local raw processing only. No personal names/email addresses, credential values, customer IP/endpoint inventories, or tenant/cluster IDs in distributable reports. Necessary linkage remains under analysis/private.
coverage_rule: Disclose files and records parsed, skips and errors, unresolved identities, missing archive families, and historical/current source differences. Absence from analyzed material is not evidence of no impact.
source_references: Gateway: logical CSV record ordinal including header and malformed yielded records. Rest CSV: 1-based logical data row, header excluded. Core JSONL: 1-based nonblank JSONL record. Support/ops/text JSONL or logs: 1-based physical line. Parquet: 1-based row. BQ: private source aliases map to nested members; line references are 1-based physical NDJSON lines including blank or malformed lines. Multiline CSV records are not physical lines.
gateway_limit: Input filenames include .sample.csv. Completeness relative to original production traffic and sampling policy are unknown.
ip_geolocation_status: Not performed: optional official DB-IP Lite download rejected with HTTP 403 / Cloudflare error 1010. No workaround or substitute database was used.
bq_scope: Progressive, explicitly selected table scans; completed inventory is not comprehensive row analysis. See bq_coverage.json for exact scope and limits.
